rajaampat.d: Piaynemo karst viewpoint stairs (out and back, short, easy, Oct-Apr); Wayag viewpoint (out and back, short rock scramble, steep, Oct-Apr)

redwood.d: Fern Canyon (loop, about 1 mile with creek wading, easy, year-round; reservation May 15 to Sep 15); James Irvine and Miners Ridge loop (loop, about 12 miles, steady, year-round); Lady Bird Johnson Grove (loop, about 1.5 miles, easy, year-round)
redwood.st: NPS conditions (via search, spring 2026): Miners Ridge Trail partly open since 12 Apr 2026 with a downed tree blocking the way to Gold Bluffs Beach (James Irvine Trail is the alternative); Dolason Prairie Trail closed at the Emerald Creek Bridge after a bridge failure; the easternmost James Irvine stairs near Fern Canyon are under construction. Expect ankle to knee deep water in Fern Canyon and two stream crossings on the road in.

rio.d: Pedra da Gavea (out and back, about 5 miles with an exposed rock section, steep, May-Sep; guide advised); Pico da Tijuca (out and back, about 3 miles, steep, May-Sep); Dois Irmaos (out and back, about 2 miles, steady, May-Sep); Pedra do Telegrafo (out and back, about 2 miles, steady, May-Sep)

rioja.d: Ebro River and vineyard loops from Haro or Laguardia (loop, about 4 to 8 miles, easy, Mar-Nov); Sierra de Cantabria trails above Laguardia (out and back, steady, Mar-Nov)

rivieramaya.d: Coba forest paths (loop, short, easy, Nov-Apr); cenote nature trails (loop, short, easy, Nov-Apr)

rocky-mountain.d: Bear Lake to Emerald Lake (out and back, about 3.6 miles, steady, Jun-Oct); Sky Pond by Glacier Gorge (out and back, about 9 miles, steep, Jul-Sep); Flattop Mountain (out and back, about 8.8 miles, steady, Jul-Sep)
rocky-mountain.m: North Inlet and Tonahutu Loop (3 to 4 days, about 28 miles, backcountry camps, trek, Jul-Sep)

rome.d: Via Appia Antica (point to point, about 5 miles, easy, year-round); Lake Albano shore path in the Castelli Romani (loop, easy to steady, Mar-Nov)

rwanda.d: Dian Fossey grave hike (out and back, 3 to 7 hours depending on the route, steady, Jun-Sep and Dec-Feb; park guide required); Mount Bisoke crater lake (out and back, about 7 miles, steep, Jun-Sep and Dec-Feb)
rwanda.m: Mount Karisimbi (2 days, 14,787 feet, camping near the saddle, strenuous trek, Jun-Sep and Dec-Feb)

san-miguel-guanajuato.d: Sierra de Santa Rosa loop (loop, about 4.7 miles, steady, Oct-Mar); El Charco del Ingenio garden paths (loop, about 1 to 3 miles, easy, Oct-Mar)

santorini.d: Fira to Oia caldera path (point to point, about 6.5 miles, steady, Apr-May and Oct); Ancient Thera from Perissa or Kamari (out and back, short climb, steep, Apr-May and Oct)

sardinia.d: Cala Goloritze (out and back, about 4 miles, steep, Apr-Jun and Sep-Oct); Gola Su Gorropu (out and back, about 7 miles, steady, Apr-Jun and Sep-Oct)
sardinia.m: Selvaggio Blu (5 to 7 days, about 28 miles of technical coast with scrambling and abseils, camping, expedition trek, Apr-May and Sep-Oct)

scottish-highlands-skye.d: Old Man of Storr (out and back, about 2.5 miles, steep, May-Sep); Quiraing circuit (loop, about 4 miles, steady, May-Sep); Fairy Pools (out and back, about 2.5 miles, easy, May-Sep)
scottish-highlands-skye.m: West Highland Way (6 to 8 days, 96 miles, B&Bs and camping, trek, Apr-Sep)

sedona.d: Cathedral Rock (out and back, about 1.2 miles with a hands-on scramble, steep, Oct-Apr); Devil's Bridge (out and back, about 4 miles, steady, Oct-Apr); Boynton Canyon (out and back, about 6 miles, steady, Oct-Apr)

seoul.d: Bukhansan to Baegundae (out and back, about 6 miles, steep, Mar-May and Sep-Nov); Seoul City Wall trail (point to point, about 11 miles in four sections, easy to steady, year-round); Namsan loop (loop, about 2 miles, easy, year-round)

sequoia-kings-canyon.d: Congress Trail (loop, about 2 miles, easy, year-round); Moro Rock (out and back, about 0.5 miles with about 350 steps, steep, year-round); Zumwalt Meadow (loop, about 1.5 miles, easy, Apr-Oct)
sequoia-kings-canyon.m: Rae Lakes Loop (4 to 6 days, 41.4 miles, camping with a permit, strenuous trek, Jul-Sep); High Sierra Trail (6 to 8 days, about 72 miles, camping with a permit, trek, Jul-Sep)
sequoia-kings-canyon.st: I could not confirm 2026 road and trail status. NPS road pages list Middle Fork Road and South Fork Road closed for flood and landslide repairs, and a 2024 NPS page said the Crescent Meadow Road and Moro Rock loop road were destroyed in the 2022-23 winter storms and Crystal Cave Road was closed; check nps.gov/seki before planning.

seychelles.d: Anse Major coastal trail (out and back, about 3 miles, easy to steady, May-Oct); Morne Blanc (out and back, about 2 miles, steep, May-Oct)

sicily.d: Etna south-side craters near Rifugio Sapienza (loop, about 2 to 5 miles, steady, May-Oct; guide required above about 2,750 m); Zingaro Nature Reserve coastal path (point to point, about 4.3 miles, easy to steady, Mar-Oct)
sicily.st: Etna: unguided walkers are limited to about 2,750 m (south) or 2,850 m (north); the summit craters near 3,300 m are guide-only and open only when the volcano allows (INGV sets the limits). One Komoot page says the hike ends at the central crater since the 2024 eruption because the terrain became impassable, while other guides describe 2,900 m as the closest public approach. The cable car can stop without notice.

singapore.d: Southern Ridges (point to point, about 6 miles from Mount Faber to Kent Ridge, easy, year-round)

snowdonia.d: Snowdon by the Pyg Track and Miners' Track (loop, about 7.5 miles, steep, May-Oct); Watkin Path (out and back, about 8 miles, steep, May-Oct)
snowdonia.m: Snowdonia Slate Trail (7 to 8 days, about 83 miles, B&Bs, trek, Apr-Oct)

southeast-alaska.d: Mendenhall West Glacier Trail (out and back, about 6 miles, unmaintained, steep, Jun-Aug)
southeast-alaska.m: Chilkoot Trail (3 to 5 days, 33 miles, campsites and shelters, trek, Jun-Sep)
southeast-alaska.st: The Chilkoot Trail border crossing is currently prohibited: hikers can use the US or the Canadian side only and must turn around at the border, and a December 2025 industry update expected this to last at least another two to three years (NPS page updated 2 June 2026). Permits are required 1 June to 12 Sept and an in-person orientation is mandatory.

srilanka.d: Adam's Peak, Sri Pada (night ascent, about 5,000 steps, steep, Dec-May); Ella Rock (out and back, about 6 miles, steady, Dec-Mar and Jul-Sep); Pidurangala Rock (out and back, about 1.5 miles, steep, year-round)
srilanka.m: Knuckles Range treks (2 to 3 days, camping or village stays, trek, Jan-Apr)

st-andrews-fife.d: St Andrews to Crail on the Fife Coastal Path (point to point, about 10 miles, easy to steady, Apr-Oct)
st-andrews-fife.m: Fife Coastal Path (7 days, about 117 miles, B&Bs, trek, Apr-Oct)

svalbard.d: Longyearbyen valley walks (guided, easy to steady, Jun-Aug); Sarkofagen (guided walk-up summit, steep, Jun-Aug)

swissalps.d: Five Lakes Walk from Blauherd (point to point, about 6 miles, easy to steady, Jul-Sep); Gornergrat to Riffelberg (point to point, about 2.5 miles downhill, easy, Jul-Sep)
swissalps.m: Walker's Haute Route from Chamonix to Zermatt (12 to 14 days, 130 miles, mountain huts and hotels, trek, Jul-Sep)
swissalps.st: A travel-guide site lists the Gornergrat railway as closed for annual maintenance on 2 to 14 November 2026 (unconfirmed; check the operator). The Zermatt to Edelweiss and Trift trail was destroyed in the June 2024 flood and its current status is unknown.

sydney.d: Coast Track in Royal National Park (point to point, 16 miles usually over two days, steady, year-round); Grand Canyon Track at Blackheath (loop, about 4 miles, steady, year-round); Three Sisters walk at Katoomba (out and back, about 2 miles, steady, year-round)
sydney.st: NPWS alerts from May to June 2026: Furber Steps and the Round walking track (Katoomba) were closed 20 May to 30 June for upgrade works, Honeymoon Bridge was closed for rockfall hazard, and track works were under way on the Coast Track between Wedding Cake Rock and Big Marley beach. The Grand Canyon Track remained open. Check NPWS alerts.
